exposure: internship training in obstetrics and anaesthesia
outcome: adequacy of training for performing caesarean sections independently and safely
exposure to different types of caesarean sections and anaesthetic procedures
cohort: 160 community service officers (CSOs) in KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa, in 2020
finding: The survey revealed deficiencies in caesarean section-related training among interns in South Africa, particularly regarding exposure to complicated cases and obstetric general anaesthesia, potentially impacting the safety and quality of caesarean section services.
